title: Fallout 3 — Structured Changed Form / Save RefID Resolution Gate v3.2c
question: Can Fallout 3 Changed Forms be structurally indexed and their 3-byte save RefIDs resolved to full FormIDs with FO3-specific implementation evidence, so future T0/T1/T2/T3 saves can test James runtime persistence without raw-byte coincidence?

wrye_bash_v3_2b_clue.previous: The shared Wrye Bash save-header module contains a six-named-offset rewrite path including changeFormsOffset; FO3 applicability was left OPEN.
wrye_bash_v3_2b_clue.finding: FalloutNVSaveHeader overrides the base master rewrite with a five-offset path. Fallout3SaveHeader inherits FalloutNVSaveHeader and changes the game marker to 0x15. Therefore the generic six-named-offset comment is not itself the FO3 method-resolution proof.
wrye_bash_v3_2b_clue.effect: The historical clue remains recorded, but it cannot be cited as proof of FO3 Changed Forms addressability.

replacement_authority.scope: Direct Fallout 3 save definition; DefineFO3SavesS is annotated as based on the Runtime.

file_location_table.significance: Changed Forms are directly addressable in the FO3 save definition rather than inferred from a neighboring game.

fields: Data length selected by length code
changed_form_header.type_semantics: lower six bits encode change type; upper two bits encode length code

length_code_semantics.3: not admitted by reviewed xEdit decoder branch

formid_array_resolution.finding: xEdit initializes a SaveRefIDArray from the FormIDs chapter; for save RefID class 0, GetSaveRefID(index) resolves index-1 into that array.
formid_array_resolution.created_form_boundary: xEdit treats save RefID values whose top two bits equal 2 as constructed/created forms.

findings: 3-byte save RefID is read big-endian within its three bytes.
top two bits encode RefID class and lower 22 bits encode value.
Changed Form parser independently agrees on 3-byte RefID, uint32 change flags, low-6-bit change type, high-2-bit length code, version byte and variable-width payload length.
File Location Table independently agrees on absolute ChangedFormsOffset and ChangedFormsCount.
independent_refid_crosscheck.authority_rule: Used as an independent implementation cross-check; xEdit FO3 definition remains the primary format authority for this gate.

pipeline: authenticate FO3 header and ordered plugin list with v3.2a
parse the 0x6E FO3 File Location Table immediately after plugin information
parse the FormID lookup array from its absolute offset
index exactly ChangedFormsCount records from ChangedFormsOffset
decode only Changed Form header grammar and payload length
hash but do not semantically decode Changed Form payload bytes
resolve save RefID to full FormID where class semantics are admitted
match resolved records against frozen James/MQ04 anchors
compare target record presence/header fingerprints across T0/T1/T2/T3 only when plugin manifests match

first_break_model.chain: FO3_HEADER_AUTH -> FLT_GRAMMAR -> CHANGED_FORM_GRAMMAR -> REFID_RESOLUTION -> [REAL_T0_T3_EXECUTION] -> JAMES_BINDING -> CROSS_EXIT_PERSISTENCE -> PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS -> IN_WORLD_SERIALIZATION
first_break_model.meaning: The format path needed to ask the James runtime question is now implemented and source-bound. The remaining block is empirical: no real T0/T1/T2/T3 .fos set is currently present.

allowed: Fallout 3 save definitions expose a directly addressable Changed Forms chapter and Changed Forms count.
Changed Form headers and save RefIDs can be structurally indexed without raw four-byte FormID searching.
Future authenticated saves can bind a Changed Form to MQDadRef or another frozen anchor through the save RefID/FormID-array mechanism.
not_allowed: MQDadRef is already proven to have a Changed Form in any user save.
A Changed Form for James is autobiographical memory.
Persistence of a Changed Form across T2->T3 is a Braun memory backup.
A Changed Form payload is a portable carrier or memory chip.
SAVE JAMES is a shipped vanilla gameplay rescue branch.

next_gate.name: FALLOUT-3-JAMES-REAL-T0-T3-STRUCTURED-CHANGED-FORM-EXECUTION-v3.3
next_gate.minimum_input: At least T1/T2/T3 authenticated Fallout 3 .fos saves from one controlled lineage; T0 and a no-op pair strongly preferred.
execution_order: run v3.2c structural Changed Form index
extract matches for MQDadRef and controls
compare record presence, change flags, type, version, size and payload hash across T1/T2/T3
only after a stable James-specific runtime record is established, inspect the xEdit per-change-type payload grammar relevant to that record
